notes.title: [Hotfix] 0.8.2
[Hotfix] 0.8.1
notes.notes:
Fixed:
- outro text not showing up when 'finishing' the game
- you can now use the old tv to switch back to the colorful view
- enemies not receiving damage at the end

Thank you all,
-- Raul

notes.title: Classified Stories: Color Out of Space is out
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

After some delays we managed to launch the first version of [b]Classified Stories: Color Out of Space[/b]
We will continue updating the game and add new content in the near future.

I hope you all will enjoy it!

Once again, thank you all for your support!

--Raul from RVL Games
